report.explanation: Order is the only degraded service: error_rate 0.16, p95 440ms, 7 unhandled 500s, and an ERROR checkout span at 1350ms. Gateway and payment are healthy, and order shows zero dependency timeouts and zero db pool waiters, so no specific taxonomy cause is established. Current evidence bounds the fault to order but not its mechanism; hand off for deeper order-side telemetry.
missing_evidence: Order service error/exception detail (stack traces, failing span attributes) to identify the fault mechanism
Inventory service metrics/logs to test downstream-latency or redis-timeout causes
Postgres/DB pool metrics for order to test db-pool-exhaustion
Order service configuration and recent change records to test bad-configuration
Order memory-retention time series to test memory-leak
